objective: Price only the nine generated 128x128-bit 1RW parent-scratch macros. Pair the sealed M504 all-write 1RW cycles with M504's own physical macro reads, RAW forwards and writes; pair the sealed M528 dead-write-only cycles with its own traffic; then report a per-frozen-sampled-inference datasheet component model without creating C1, full-network or system energy.

analyzer_binding.anti_cycle_rule: This contract intentionally does not embed the analyzer SHA. The analyzer embeds this contract's exact SHA; the double-sealed author handoff and fresh static hammer bind the analyzer SHA.

frozen_model.component: 9 x TS1N28HPCPHVTB128X128M4S; 128x128-bit 1RW SP; lower 64 rows used; all nine slices activated for one logical 1152-bit access
frozen_model.sample_unit: one frozen sampled inference window; not asserted to be a camera frame
frozen_model.read_energy_equation: 9 * readc_uA_per_MHz * 0.9 V = pJ per full 1152-bit macro read
frozen_model.write_energy_equation: 9 * writec_uA_per_MHz * 0.9 V = pJ per full 1152-bit macro write
frozen_model.dynamic_energy_equation: (read_accesses * read_pJ + write_accesses * write_pJ) / 10 frozen sampled inferences
frozen_model.leakage_energy_equation: 9 * leakage_uA * 0.9 V * cycles * 3 ns / 10 frozen sampled inferences
frozen_model.leakage_assumption: all nine macros remain powered and leak for the complete modeled four-Conv sample schedule; no power gating is credited

repair_lineage.p0_closed_by_design: M504 all-write macro reads/writes/forwards/cycles are taken directly from the sealed M504 result and hammer; M473 parent-edge traffic is not an energy source.
repair_lineage.p1_closed_by_design: Every business input path/SHA and every sealed-directory manifest/outer identity is analyzer-internal; the CLI accepts no input path or expected SHA.
repair_lineage.p2_closed_by_design: Future rows retain source identity, per-output-block read/forward/write counts, bank/word multipliers and explicit conservation booleans.

mandatory_static_hammer_checks: Python 3.6 compatibility and strict duplicate/nonfinite JSON rejection
exact r2 contract SHA and exact top-level/nested contract key/value binding before business-input parsing
no caller-supplied business input path or expected SHA exists
all sealed input directories pass exact manifest and outer seal before JSON parsing
M504 result hammer admits a trustworthy exact CPU M504 audit even though M504 RTL remains NO-GO
M528 result hammer admits exact CPU traffic while retaining logical-bytes-not-energy boundary
M504 reads plus RAW forwards equal parent edges and M504 writes equal active rows
M504 macro reads equal M528 dead-only macro reads; RAW forwards are never charged as macro reads
dead-only writes plus dead-write elisions equal active rows
all byte counts equal per-output-block physical macro accesses times 8 banks times 144 B
generated macro shape, 13-of-13 checksum status, slow 0.9-V datasheet fields and nine-macro area are exact
component dynamic/leakage equations and units are independently recomputed
result labels use per-frozen-sampled-inference rather than per-frame
result remains parent-scratch generated-macro datasheet component only and excludes integrated PPA, logic, interconnect, all other memories, DRAM, C1 total, full network, silicon and DATE headline
no canonical result, attempt, runner, launch admission, EDA, GPU or remote action is created

claim_boundary.allowed_only_after_future_result_hammer: dead-write suppression reduces the generated-macro datasheet component model of parent-scratch energy versus the all-write M504 1RW schedule on the frozen four-Conv S10 workload

accepting caller-selected business input paths or expected SHA values
charging a same-address RAW forward as a parent-scratch macro read
using M473 parent-edge read traffic as M504 physical macro-read traffic
